title: Visual daily routine
examples: Teacher, what do we do after playtime?
Can you show me the order of our day?
What happens between snack time and circle time?

explain.say: A routine is the things you do each day, in the same order. A picture board shows what comes next.
Look at this calm bedroom at bedtime. Can you see the bed and the lamp? Tap any part to hear about it.
A first-then board shows two pictures. The first picture is what you do now. The then picture comes next.
For example, first you wash your hands. Then you eat your lunch.
Moving from one activity to the next is called a transition. Going from play time to quiet time is a transition.
At home, first you put your school bag down. Then you wash your hands with soap.

draw.text: First: bag down. Then: wash hands.

faq.a: A routine is a regular pattern of activities that happen every day. It helps us feel safe and know what to expect.

faq.q: What do first then boards show?
faq.a: They show the order of two things happening one after the other. It tells us what comes right after the first thing.
asks: How do I use the first then board?

faq.a: A transition is the time we move from one activity to the next. It helps us change our focus gently.
asks: How do we move from one thing to another?

faq.q: If we finish playtime, what comes next?
faq.a: You should look at our routine board. It will show the next activity we need to do together.
asks: Where can I see what is next?

faq.q: Do we always do things in the same order?
faq.a: Most days we do things in the same order. This helps our brains know what to expect every day.
asks: Is our day always the same?
Does the schedule always stay the same?

facts: A routine helps children feel calm and secure.
First then boards show a clear sequence of two events.
Transitions help us move smoothly between different activities.
Knowing the schedule helps us prepare for what comes next.

quiz.say: Look at the board. Tap what you do first.
quiz.why: The first picture shows soap. So you wash your hands first.

wrong.0: Lunch is the then picture, so it comes after washing your hands.
wrong.2: Playing outside is a different part of the day.

quiz.say: Look at the board. Tap what comes after painting.
quiz.why: The then picture shows books. So reading comes after painting.

wrong.0: Bath time is at home in the evening, and the board shows books next.
wrong.1: Snack is a different picture, and the board shows books next.

quiz.say: Look at the three pictures. Tap what comes last.
quiz.why: The door is the last picture. So going home comes last.

wrong.1: The coat is the first picture, so it comes first.
wrong.2: The bag is in the middle, so it comes second.
